usageNotice: Research references for clearly marked fictional Takeover demo listings. These are not offers to sell the referenced eBay items. Source prices remain in EUR; demo CHF amounts are invented and are not currency conversions. All syntheticDemo locations, dimensions, pickup logistics and condition wording are fictional demo choices. No seller names or contacts are included. Public product photographs are referenced by external URL with per-image provenance; no image files are downloaded or redistributed.
method: Public web search followed by reading public eBay listing pages. No account access, contact, bids or transactions. Evidence represents page text returned by the research tools, which may be cached. Availability is not guaranteed.
